Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves; arrows fire/aim/set facing; movement+fire combine; tears auto-fire in facing direction. E places/uses bomb; Space activates pedestal/item; Q uses/drops card (no confirmed effect). Fine movement: 0.1s≈40px, 0.2s≈80px, 0.3s≈120px, 0.5s≈200px. Door/hatch/alcove transitions require centered overlap PLUS 2-3 repeated presses; standing inside the alcove and pressing again helps; a single press almost never works. Player sprite renders inconsistently (white/pink blob, TV-head, gray face) and can resemble enemies/spiders—confirm identity by moving. In the dark stone room, Tech X rings sometimes burst repeatedly without obvious input (unexplained).

HUD/PICKUPS (observed): hearts go hollow after damage; blue/soul hearts from blue pill; counters for coins, keys, bombs; item/card slots. All-hollow hearts observed repeatedly; in one case it preceded a run end, but in another the room stayed interactive and controllable—treat as critical/possibly terminal. Pickups on touch, but coins need exact overlap. Poop sometimes hides/releases items; some poop inert. Chests may damage once on contact; some vanish, revert to closed, or act mimic-like. A coin can spawn on the floor of the two-poop chamber.

TECH X (observed): radial ring tear with red X impact; radius ~140-150px; blocks line of fire; point-blank unsafe. Damages fats, gray faces, shelled, flies, clustered spiders. Does NOT crack rock rings or TNT barrels; boss-room statue showed no damage feedback; embedded eye-faces survived blasts (likely invulnerable, uncertain). y-offset >~70px misses. Item banners (TECH X; MATCH STICK; 2 OF SPADES—'Item multiplier') can replace the active item; after Match Stick, ring bursts were not visibly firing (unconfirmed).

ENEMIES: winged flies are tanky, chase/fire tears downward, and often guard hatches. Fat pink/white/gray-faced enemies are very tanky, enrage with red aura/tint, chase relentlessly, contact drains hearts fast, and die in red splatter. Shelled white-faced enemies emerge from spiky rock piles, fire blue/green orbs, and leave damaging green spiky clouds that persist and can finish a 1-HP player—never linger near them. Bomb-bugs are burst-immune and explode on contact, chaining TNT barrels. Black spiders cluster and are deadly at close range. Green spiky clouds, poison puddles, brazier flames, and enemy orbs damage. Gilded sack with a fly in the boss room fires teardrops (possible mimic).

NAVIGATION (observed): Tutorial room ('BASEMENT I'): top hatch ↔ rock/shop room; bottom hatch ↔ brazier room; right-wall dark riveted door ↔ dark stone room. Rock/shop room: left gold-framed door has a keyhole and never opened (with 0 keys); shop previously sold bomb 5¢, card 15¢; bottom hatch ↔ tutorial; top hatch ↔ TNT room (transition works after clearing enemies + centered alcove + repeats). TNT room: two isolated TNT barrels mid-room flank a safe central gap; left wall has TNT cluster, gray stone crates, a reddish barrel; a bomb-bug patrols the left side; top hatch ↔ boss room; bottom trapdoor ↔ rock room. Boss room: central rock pile blocks fire lanes; dark left-wall statue with red glow/eyes undamaged by attacks; embedded eye-faces in right rock wall; gilded sack with a fly at right that shoots teardrops; card on floor; bottom trapdoor ↔ TNT room; no other exit observed. Brazier room: four damaging corner braziers; central chest enclosed in a solid rock ring—unreachable by walking, and bombs and TECH X failed; poop left of the ring is inert; bottom-center golden gate ↔ two-poop chamber; top-center alcove ↔ tutorial room; the left side/corridor bypasses the ring. Two-poop chamber: two poops flank a central rock, all inert to tears and contact; a faint gray outlined floor tile recurs at the same spot but never opens (likely a shadow artifact, not a crawlspace); a thin yellow key-like sliver appeared there and vanished without raising the key counter (likely decorative); top golden gate ↔ brazier room; otherwise a dead end. Dark stone room: left exit ↔ tutorial; two red-barred chests on top wall (left one briefly appeared open then closed again—contact effect uncertain); central red spiked chest inside a white spike cross that damages on touch; two floor holes (probably pits); black spiders spawn inside. Extremely punishing—nearly lost the run there; retreat to tutorial at low HP.

FAILED/CAUTION: attacking the boss-room statue; attacking embedded eye-faces; shooting bomb-bugs; assuming chests won't hurt; lingering in green/poison clouds or brazier fire; shooting into adjacent walls/rocks; assuming one press opens hatches/trapdoors; assuming coins collect on near-touch; assuming all poop yields loot; assuming Q card works; entering the dark stone room below ~2 hearts. In the boss room, fighting two enraged fats at close range drained hearts to near-death—kiting around the central rock pile with 100px+ row-aligned fire is the safer tactic; the bottom trapdoor is the reliable escape when critical.

UNRESOLVED: how to progress past the boss/TNT/statue loop or what damages the statue; whether eye-faces are invulnerable or high-HP; what the gilded sack/creature is (boss trigger vs mimic); whether red-barred/spiked dark-room chests open and what the floor holes do; card effects (Q unclear; 2 of Spades unknown); meaning of all-hollow hearts; how to reach the brazier-room ring chest (method unknown; walking, bombs, TECH X all failed); whether the shop keyhole door truly needs a key (it never opened without one); whether room clearing (rather than alcove position) enables hatch transitions; whether enemy contact during a transition attempt can cancel it; whether the recurring faint gray tile is ever interactable.
